The '''2016–17 [[Cypriot First Division]]''' was the 78th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league. The season began on 20 August 2016 and ended on 21 May 2017.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/26437|title=20 – 21 Αυγούστου η πρεμιέρα|language=el|publisher=CFA|date=9 May 2016|access-date=9 May 2016}}</ref> The fixtures were announced on 7 July 2016.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/26978|title=Σε ρυθμούς Πρωταθλήματος Cyta|website=cfa.com.cy|date=7 July 2016|access-date=7 July 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/26979 |title=Το πλήρες πρόγραμμα του Πρωταθλήματος Cyta|website=cfa.com.cy|date=7 July 2016|access-date=7 July 2016}}</ref> [[APOEL FC|APOEL]] were the defending champions.

[[APOEL FC|APOEL]] were crowned champions for the 26th time and a fifth time in a row, securing the title after beating title arch-rivals [[AC Omonia|Omonia]] 3–1 at the [[GSP Stadium]] on 13 May 2017.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/30481|title=Πρωταθλητής το ΑΠΟΕΛ|publisher=cfa.com.cy|date=13 May 2017|access-date=13 May 2017}}</ref>

==Teams==

===Promotion and relegation (pre-season)===
[[Enosis Neon Paralimni FC|Enosis Neon Paralimni]] and [[Ayia Napa F.C.|Ayia Napa]] were relegated at the end of the first-phase of the [[2015–16 Cypriot First Division|2015–16 season]] after finishing in the bottom two places of the table. They were joined by [[Pafos FC]], who finished at the bottom of the second-phase relegation group.

The relegated teams were replaced by [[2015–16 Cypriot Second Division|2015–16 Second Division]] champions [[Karmiotissa FC|Karmiotissa]], runners-up [[AEZ Zakakiou]] and third-placed team [[Anagennisi Deryneia FC|Anagennisi Deryneia]].
